sources.title: avewright/chess-transformer-100m-squares64 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Chess transformer 100M (squares64 recurrent) ~99Mparameter recurrent chess policy/value net. Attention is only over the 64 board squares. Turn, castling, and en passant are FiLM on the square stream, not extra tokens.
